title: Rethinking Machine Ethics – Can LLMs Perform Moral Reasoning through the Lens of Moral Theories?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with culturally-specified moral instructions (e.g., norms from an English-speaking community perspective) versus general moral instructions to evaluate their alignment with commonsense morality datasets and highlight the underlying cultural inclinations of the data.

Conducting a manual error analysis on misaligned model predictions to identify dataset-side limitations, specifically revealing how ground-truth labels often reflect the subjective personal preferences and limited moral stances of crowd-workers rather than objective or universal moral standards.
